title: MCP fetch server IDNA parsing mismatch bypasses the private-address guard
summary: The fetch guard resolves an internationalized hostname differently from the HTTP connection. An attacker-controlled URL can reach internal services or cloud metadata and return responses to the agent.

severity.rationale: Fetching attacker URLs is normal for browsing agents. Bypassing the private-address guard can expose sensitive internal responses, including cloud metadata.

exposure: Requires an agent fetching an attacker-controlled internationalized hostname. The internal services reachable depend on the server network.

remediation.details: Upgrade mcp-server-fetch to 2026.10.24, which aligns the hostname used for checking and connecting.
remediation.risk: Low. Test dependent workflows after updating.

verification: Confirm the installed version or revision and exercise the affected workflow with trusted inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
